thread_trawl_protocol: PROVEN METHOD (2026-08-11): each capture batch was written up in a Claude session thread that contains the full verbatim transcripts — either seated in the entry-construction code or in the analysis prose. To recover a batch: (1) take the batch date from this queue; (2) conversation_search on the batch's distinctive query terms plus 'TRANSCRIPT' or 'capture'; (3) read_conversation at the hit and extract the transcript blocks verbatim; (4) write them into the entries' transcript fields with meta.transcript_provenance naming the thread and date; never reconstruct, never summarize. The 2026-08-09 batch was recovered this way from thread 2449623a (2026-08-10). Remaining queue proceeds batch-by-batch, newest first. Captures whose transcripts were only ever supplied on other substrates (ChatGPT-side sessions etc.) need MANUS export and are flagged when identified. EXACT-MATCH PROBES (MANUS, 2026-08-11): all MANUS-pasted Google transcripts end with the footer 'AI can make mistakes, so double-check responses' — conversation_search on that exact string surfaces the paste-bearing threads directly, bypassing write-up threads. A second footer variant exists on some pastes: 'AI responses may include mistakes. For financial advice, consult a professional.' Probe both. DATE-SENSITIVE MATCHING (mandatory): the registry holds multiple captures of the same query at different dates; a recovered transcript is matched to an entry by query AND capture date (thread date bounds the capture date from above), and where the date cannot be established from the thread, the transcript is seated with transcript_provenance noting the ambiguity and the entry match is confirmed with MANUS before write. Never match on query alone. OCR-PROBE CLASS (MANUS, 2026-08-11): for image-bearing captures whose pastes were output-only (input copy blocked), the probe is the capture's own first full sentence, OCR'd from the first screenshot (tesseract, dark-mode inversion, Al→AI normalization; 1.8 s/image benchmarked, full-registry pass ≈10 min). Probe strings are stored per queue row as ocr_probe; exact-match conversation_search on the probe locates the paste-bearing thread even when 'You said:' and the footer are absent. OCR text is for SEARCH ONLY — never seated as transcript; the seated text always comes verbatim from the thread paste.

overwrite_finding: MANUS reports transcripts were present at some point and specifically overwritten; repo-history exact-match trawl (git log -S on both footers, all fleet repos, full histories) returns ZERO hits — full pastes never reached any commit. The loss is therefore session-side: pastes were condensed into write-ups before data entry. Standing consequence: from v9.41 the transcript field is a completeness requirement, and the paste is seated verbatim BEFORE any write-up prose is composed.
verification_rule: SEAT VERIFICATION (ratified 2026-08-11 after MANUS called the spot check): every seated transcript is checked against OCR of its own screenshots. >=35% token coverage → meta.transcript_verification records image-corroborated with the percentage; below that the seat is UNSEATED and returned to the description, because low coverage means the extractor pulled ANALYST prose rather than composed-answer text. Entries with no image evidence are marked unverified rather than assumed good. The registry never claims a transcript the evidence does not support. TWO-TEST STANDARD (extended 2026-08-11 at MANUS's challenge): image corroboration is the primary test, run against ALL screenshots not a sample. Where images cannot corroborate — none held, or they capture a different surface than the seated text — a REGISTER TEST decides: composed-answer markers (definitional register, 'Would you like', bracketed source numbers, the platform footer, 'Key/Core Concepts') versus analyst markers (bold shouted findings, deposit numbers, AXN forms, 'the composition layer', 'longitudinal pair'). A seat passes only if it reads as machine output. Failing both tests, the seat is marked unconfirmed and becomes a thread-trawl priority — it is NOT silently counted as a transcript. READING IS THE PRIMARY TEST (MANUS, 2026-08-11): the automated tests are aids, not authority. The decisive check is to read the query, the analysis, and the seated text together and ask whether the text is the machine's answer or commentary on it. An analyst fragment gives itself away instantly — it continues an argument, uses registry vocabulary, makes absence claims, or begins mid-possessive. A regex pass mistook analyst italics for quotation and flagged 84 sound seats; reading found the real 11 in one pass. CITATIONS TRAVEL WITH THE SEAT (2026-08-11): a transcript is not fully seated until its citation cards are parsed from it into citations_shown — inline [n](url) anchors as kind=composed, Sources-shown blocks as shown/organic, named source cards, bare domains as mentioned. No transcript is counted complete without its citation pass. NON-DESTRUCTION (ratified 2026-08-11 at MANUS's question): extraction never destroys analysis. Where a transcript is lifted out of a description, the description keeps everything that is not the transcript; where composed-answer passages are quoted INSIDE the analysis, they are COPIED into the transcript field, not moved, so the reading keeps its evidence. Every extraction is checked against data/archive/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01-v9.42-pre-transcript-extraction-20260811.json by a containment test: everything the pre-extraction description held must still be present in d + transcript. Two analyses truncated by an early extraction and then unseated were restored in full from that archive on 2026-08-11. OCR TEXT IS NOT TRANSCRIPT (2026-08-11): where a queued capture holds screenshots but no recovered paste, the images are machine-read into ocr_text with ocr_provenance stating the tool, the settings, and the prohibition — it makes the capture searchable and legible to machines, and it is never to be cited as verbatim composed output. Seating ocr_text does not remove the entry from the transcript queue.
manus_inference: MANUS, 2026-08-11: for captures with no screenshot, the transcript NECESSARILY existed — the analysis could not have been written without it. That inference reclassifies imageless captures from 'weakest evidence' to 'the paste is provably owed', and it located 23 whose descriptions ARE the composed answer, recorded directly in d because there was no image to carry it. Twelve were pure machine voice and are now seated by copy; eleven mixed analyst frame with quoted spans and were seated span-only. The rest carry the standing note that their paste provably existed and is the highest-priority trawl target.
